'''D'aarmont''' was a natural [[Quartz/Legends|quartz]] outcropping on [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]], located at the confluence of the [[East River]] and [[West River]], on top of which sat the capital of Bakura, [[Salis D'aar/Legends|Salis D'aar]]. D'aarmont measured three kilometers in length and fifty kilometers in width, providing a suitable base for a thriving city. The outcropping was formed as the two rivers eroded the softer rock around it.<ref name="GatORW" />

Just south of Salis D'aar, D'aarmont also hosted the Bakura spaceport and, during the reign of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] garrison.<ref name="GatORW" />
